page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, with Latin, Hebrew and citations in mixed type. Running head centred at top; page number top right. Large Hebrew headwords stand in the left margin beside their entries. Catchword "cujus" at bottom right.

main_text.p: אֵיUbi? Genes.4.9. אַי־וֶה[?] Ubi ista, scil. sit, 1.Sam.9.18. Quanam? 1.Reg.22.24. Ubinam, Quaenam, Jer.6.16. Qualenam, Quodnam; Eccles.2.3. Et absq. Makkaph, אֵי זֶה Quidnam; Eccles.11.6. אֵי מִזֶּה הַבּוֹא Ubi ex quo venis? 2.Sam.1.3. hoc est, Undenam? אֵי מִזֶּה אַתָּה Undenam es? v.13. Jungitur etiam cum פֹּה, vide illic.

אֵיךְQuomodo? Gen.39.9. אֵיכָה Idem; Deut.1.12. Ubinam? Cant.1.7. Et cum Cholem, אֵיכֹה Ubi-nam,2.Reg.6.13. quasi pro אֵיכֹה de quo in פֹּה. Et geminato Caph, אֵיכְכָה Quomodo? Esth.8.6. Duo sunt penacuta, אֵיכָכָה Cant.5.3.
אֵילm. Fortitudo, Virtus; כִּגְבַר אֵין אֵיל Sicut vir sine virtute aut viribus, Psal.88.5.
אֵילוּתf. Idem: Aff. אֵילוּתִי Virtus mea, Psal.22.20.

אַיִלm. Aries, Num.28.27. Item Superliminare, Limen, 1.Reg.6.31. Ezech.40.14. Constr. מִלְבַּד אֵיל Praeter arietem, Numer.5.8. Et absq. Joth, אֵל אֵלָם Limen vestibuli, Ezech.40.48. Plur. אֵילִים Arietes, Mich.6.7. לְאֵילִים Liminibus, Ezech.40.10. אֵת אֵילִים Superliminaria, Ezeth. 40.14. Constr. אֵילֵי Arietes,Gen.31.39. אֵילֵיהֶמָּה Superli-minaribus eorum; cum ה paragogico, pro אֵילֵיהֶם Ezech. 40.16. אֵילָו Limina ejus, v.24. vide & mox in אל.
אֵילm. Planicies; אֵיל פָּרָן Planicies Paran, Gen.14.6.

אַלּוֹןm. Idem: עַד אֵלּוֹן מוֹרֶה Usq. ad planiciem More, Gen.12.6. Plural. constr. בְּאֵלוֹנֵי מַמְרֵא In campestribus planis Mamre, Genes.14.13. Quidam Quercetum explicant, quasi idem cum אֵלָה, de quo in אֵלָה.
אַיִּלm. Cervus, quasi Aries ferus vel sylvestris, juxta quosdam, Deut.15.22. Plur. אֵילִים Cervi, Cant.2.9. Foeminine legitur Psal.42.2. cujus diversas causas Hebr. reddunt.
אַיָּלֶתf. Cerva, Genes.49.21. vel אַיֶּלֶת Prov.5.19. עַל אַיֶּלֶת Ad cervam aurora, Psal.22.1. quod alii Initium ali-

page.notes: Hebrew in the first entry (after "Ubi ista") is uncertain, marked [?]. Some Hebrew vowel points in the entries of אֵיכָה and אֵילִים are hard to read at this scan resolution; letters are copied as far as visible. The large headwords in the left margin are treated as notes. The entry "Quomodo?" Hebrew (אֵיכְכָה) and the last Hebrew line are only partly legible. The entry at the foot ends on a hyphenated word; the catchword is "cujus".
